text: The road is severely damaged and needs repair.
Road romba mosama. Enga theru la periya potholes irukku.
Enga area la moonu naala thanni varala.
हमारे मोहल्ले में तीन दिन से पानी नहीं आ रहा है।
Street la garbage edukkave illa, romba smell varudhu.
The drane is blokd and sewag is floding the street.
A live electric wire is lying on the road near children.
আমাদের রাস্তায় অনেক বড় গর্ত হয়েছে।

The drain near Gandhi School has been blocked for three days. Sewage and uncollected rubbish cover the street, and the road surface is broken. Please clear the drain, remove the waste, and repair the road.
Enga theru la kudineer pipe odanju rendu naala thanni leak aagudhu. Andha idathula road um odanju periya pothole irukku. Pipe um road um sari pannunga.
Garbage has not been collected on Temple Road for four days. The road is not damaged, and the drain is not blocked.
Something is wrong in our area, but I cannot tell what it is.
